extraction.Name: Willie Swallow
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want a patent in fee for his land, but that he took it for the reason that he was told that if he did not take it and pay the taxes that he would lose the land and get nothing for it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged 1 quarter for $700.00 to pay taxes, then sold all of it
extraction.Buyer: Sold to Daniel Swallow for $3200.00, he to pay the taxes; has paid $1000.00 and owes $1500.00 and is to pay the mortgage
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not pay the taxes so he mortgaged 1 quarter for $700.00 to pay them, that he could not pay the mortgage or taxes so he had to sell all of it or lose it
extraction.Occupation/Income: farms for a living on the allotment of his father in law, but that he does not make much
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, in fair health; has no money or property; has a wife and 6 minor children depending on him for support; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since his patent was issued to him; sworn before notary public November 28, 1928 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
